title: Usher

title: Sports Instructor

listing.title: Sports Instructor
listing.description: Plan and teach instructional sports activities, keep participants engaged and safe, and coordinate with volunteers. The City advertises one new part-time vacancy. Work may include evenings and weekends. The source publishes an hourly range of $17.20–$18.25; confirm the current applicable rate with the employer. Applications close 2026-12-31; no closing time is stated in the public posting. Check the official posting for all requirements and current pay.
listing.compensation: $17.20–$18.25 per hour, as published; confirm current applicable rate

facts: Minimum 1 year experience related to the type of activity being taught is preferred

title: Aquatic Employment (Hiring Fall 2026 - Spring 2027)

listing.title: Aquatic Employment — Fall 2026 to Spring 2027
listing.description: One recruiting campaign covering 25 existing replacement vacancies across aquatic attendant, lifeguard and swim instructor roles for Fall 2026–Spring 2027. Published hourly pay is $17.95 for attendants, $19.62 for lifeguards and Swim Instructor II, and $21.81 for Swim Instructor I. Exact hiring needs vary by pool and session; applying does not guarantee a placement. Applications close 2027-03-01; no closing time is stated in the public posting. Check the official posting for all requirements and current pay.
listing.compensation: $17.95–$21.81 per hour depending on role and certification
listing.eligibility: At least 15, valid Social Insurance Number, and current Standard or Intermediate First Aid. Aquatic Attendant: Bronze Cross. Lifeguard: National Lifeguard–Pool. Confirm each role and pool requirement in the official campaign.

facts: Be at least 15 years of age
Not all pools hire applicants each session
